title: Distinguish scope inventory from the selected optimization portfolio
description:
A scoped run must enumerate the account inventory to resolve opaque IDs and literal prefixes, but the living Report currently presents that inventory count as though every inspected scorecard were in the optimization portfolio.

Feature: Honest scoped-run coverage

Scenario: View a scoped optimization run after ranking
  Given exhaustive inventory inspected more scorecards than the selected scope contains
  When a stakeholder views the Report cover or aggregate presentation
  Then the Report separately identifies the inventory inspected and the scorecards in scope
  And ranked, assessed, and diagnosed counts are clearly associated with the selected scope

Scenario: View an account-wide run
  Given no scorecard selectors were supplied
  When a stakeholder views coverage
  Then the account inventory and selected scope are clearly equivalent

Out of scope:
- Changing exhaustive inventory behavior.
- Exposing opaque identifiers in stakeholder presentation.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production dogfood confirmed selector behavior was correct but presentation was ambiguous: a one-scorecard run displayed all 56 enumerated account scorecards as 'inspected' beside one ranked score. The stakeholder overview and aggregate component now separate account inventory inspected from scorecards in scope, while retaining scoped ranked/assessment/diagnosis counts. Focused validation is green: 46 Python tests, 11 dashboard tests, and TypeScript compilation. No change to exhaustive inventory or opaque-ID behavior.
